PowerPointは、マウスを速くするよりtouch it less――ThinkPadをslide-making machineにする

Making PowerPoint faster is not mainly about moving the mouse faster. The real friction can be separated into three costs: searching for commands, moving your hands between input devices, and re-deciding layout choices on every slide. This English Mix edition connects ThinkPad's TrackPoint and Fn/Ctrl settings with PowerPoint duplication, Quick Access Toolbar, Selection pane, alignment, and reusable slide families.
